steps.content:
2:00 p.m., January 22, N.F. 113
Eastside - Dillywood Walk of Fame

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The Lion Dancing Queen is back! You didn't see me last night, so now you get an early update! Yup yup, I know, I know... y'all really miss me! I miss you guys, too!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I've come back to the camera, and today, the crew is taking a big step forward! We're warming up for the big battle for the DisCars!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: That's right! Thanks to our little clapper ${PlayerName}, we've crossed the Rust and entered Eastside to prepare for the awards ceremony in advance. <size=28>Of course, that dummy asked for a day off and didn't come along...</size>
steps.female_content: That's right! Thanks to our little clapper ${PlayerName}, we've crossed the Rust and entered Eastside to prepare for the awards ceremony in advance. <size=25>Of course, that dummy asked for a day off and didn't come along...</size>

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: This is the place where dreams are made... Dillywood's Walk of Fame! Ta-dah...

This narrow but brightly lit street is crammed with cinemas, studios, and offices. The walls are plastered with posters, while holograms of sultry stars beam everywhere. This dreamy area stands apart even in the wealthy Eastside.
Golden confetti soar across the sky like countless little dancing suns. The atmosphere here is beyond compare. Yet the crowning jewel of all this is the upcoming DisCars Film Festival.

A bigger-than-life Golden Duck Trophy flanks the street. Celebratory music blasts day and night, while talent scouts, actors and paparazzi mingle amongst the crowd. All eyes in the city are on this avenue these few days, making it dearly exuberant.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Oh... Even though DeadLover Radio has been popular for quite a while, this is the first time I actually set foot in Eastside... Crossing the Rust was no small feat. This place is really beyond my imagination.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: It's the fragrance of flowers and makeup! It's the fragrance of dreams and joy!

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Ugh... It's the stink of money and camera flashes... It still gives me nausea after all this time...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Are you unwell, Lil Daisy? I remember that you were in the Eastside entertainment industry for a while. I was hoping you could tell me about it.

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Stop talking about it... I'm gonna puke...

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Want to say something, Lynn? I remember the photographer you like also works in Dillywood...
The girl in the rabbit helmet, who had been patting Daisy on the back, freezes for a moment, then panics.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: No no, um, I...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: What? Lynn's been to Dillywood before? Then...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: N-no, I haven't...
Five minutes later.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I-it's because Dillywood is the heart of the film industry... It has a lot of talented people and opportunities, so w-we also came here...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: My Best Cool Car Studios... is looking for a director... If you have any friends to recommend, please leave their contact info in the comments.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: That's right! You can recommend yourself, too! As long as you're a director... A directorrrrr...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Directorrrrrr... Do you hear me... The DisCars are waving to you ...

You listen to OwO's vlog from your headset. They've barely gained any followers these past few days, and the Intelligence Department is also monitoring them. Their livestream helps you keep tabs on them at all times.

The area is brimming with oddly dressed weirdos who goad tourists to take pictures and then demand money. They all excel at catching eyes and making trouble. OwO's lion head pales by comparison. You hope she doesn't get into a fight with anyone.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: <size=30>You dare look down on the Lion Dancing Queen? You think I'd let my emotions get the better of me? I definitely won't reveal my moves here! My first public performance will be onstage at the DisCars, so everyone can be awed by the wonders of lion dancing!</size>
You try imagining again, and feel that this is the more likely scenario. You can't think of anything worse, so you look up at the man in front of you.

The Dean of DisCity Film Academy, head of the DisCars Awards Ceremony, and a shareholder of a major Dillywood studios. He reacted oddly when you asked to visit on behalf of the MBCC this morning, and kept insisting on receiving you himself.

But when you actually got here, he tried his best to keep you in the office alone. Whenever you'd ask something, he'd beat around the bush and talk in circles. You have no idea what he's trying to say.

steps.speaker: Option
options: ...Sir, can I help you with anything?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've been sitting here for a long time. If something's troubling you, feel free to tell me.

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: Ah, no. No no no no no... you misunderstood. We are full of admiration for the FAC's contributions. Your presence here is an honor for Dillywood. There is nothing you should worry about.
His anxious expression says otherwise. You switch to a different channel on the covert comms system that he can't hear, and receive some updates from the MBCC Intelligence Department.

steps.speaker: Wynn (Secret Message)
steps.content: Have the Apostle's clones appeared in Dillywood, too?

steps.speaker: Wynn (Secret Message)
steps.content: Hmm... no reports on that, but it's very likely. After all, Dillywood is a dream factory with a ton of spiritual energy. They'd easily get lured to a place like that.
That's why the Dean is so scared. He thinks you're an FAC commissioner who came here to investigate.
But why would he try to hide it? You try to put him at ease.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry. If you encounter any incidents, I can report them on your behalf. Right now, everything is still under control. A short lockdown ought to solve the problem.

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: No!!! These are just some... uh... pranks! Yeah, pranks! It's not Mania! No need to bother the fine staff of the FAC!
The Dean finally can't hold out any longer. He slams his palms on the table and begins to speak in panic.

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: The film festival is about to begin. It's the most important event of the year! It must not get disrupted by Mania!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...The arts are important, but safety comes first. The sooner it gets found, the faster it can be dealt with. There shouldn't be too much disruption.

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: Mania is a disruption in itself!

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: We've invited so many celebrities, judges, guests, and media. All the contracts for sponsorships, ads and publicity have already been signed, and they're worth a fortune! Do you know how much we'd have to pay if we breach them?
Huh?
Before you have a chance to react, the man walks over the coffee table and grabs your wrist, pleading with a fawning look on his face.

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: The problem's not that bad, really. There's not that much damage. Please just wait out these few days. You can do whatever you want in a week, okay? I can give you whatever you want. Investments? Celebrity appearances?

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: Oh, and I heard that your friend is looking for Director Deren. I can help you...
You become high on alert.

steps.speaker: Option
options: You sent people to follow them?

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: No, no! I just care about young people with filmmaking dreams. Don't worry, they went back already!
Sensing your anger, he quickly fumbles out a name card.

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: Here are the contact details for Deren Film Studios. The director is very busy, so I couldn't get in touch with her personally, but her team is quite good.

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: Her assistant has already accepted the invitation for this year's DisCars, and said that Deren has agreed to be a judge for this year's awards. So as long as the ceremony can be held as usual, you'll be sure to see her!
On the ostentatious card is a glamorous, black-haired woman in sunglasses and an evening gown, who is flashing an obviously fake smile.

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: I know you want to make a movie. I can find all sorts of resources for you. Money is not a problem, nor is ticket sales! Anyone can enter the industry. You can make a movie in 10 days and still win a DisCar!
These words are so familiar to you. When spoken by OwO, they feel like the innocent, romantic but troublesome fantasies of a child. But when uttered from the Dean's mouth, they just sound absurd.
The name card in your hand is an unexpected gain, but it makes you feel uneasy. All you want to do right now is to leave this place.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Don't worry, I won't say anything.

steps.content: The man thanks you a million times and accompanies you all the way to the street. He puts you in a VIP car and keeps waving until you can't see him anymore.
You won't say anything, but everything that had been said has already been heard by Wynn on the other end. The FAC can decide how to handle it.

steps.speaker: [Scene Change]
steps.content: Night at My Best Cool Car.

9:00 p.m., January 22, N.F. 113
West bank of the Rust - My Best Cool Car parking spot
You return, completely exhausted. Before you can sit down, OwO gives you a big bear hug.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Too slow! You're slacking off! You're losing points with me, little clapper!

steps.speaker: Option
options: I'm trying hard to find Deren, too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Here is the contact information for her studio. Let me see, her name card is...
You reach for it, but then hesitate. You don't even want to bring in a whiff of her fans' adoration from Dillywood, let alone have this big director join My Best Cool Car herself.
You'd rather ask the MBCC for some reliable professionals to help out, or even learn the ropes yourself.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Name card?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: What do I need a name card for? I've already brought the best director here!
She skips back to the vehicle, and pulls out a shabby woman you've never seen before.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Welcome to today's special vlog update! ${PlayerName} is back, so everyone is here. It's time to introduce our newest member... the famous Dillywood director, D!!!

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Hehe... Good evening...

steps.speaker: Option
options: You randomly pulled someone from the street again?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Of course not. She joined on her own! We hit it off right away on the street. She also gave a lot of shopping tips, so the others went off shopping and had a lot of fun! D is the most perfect fit for our crew!

steps.speaker: Option
options: She joined on her own? And sent away the others to talk to OwO alone?

steps.content: You observe the director named D carefully, who looks very gloomy and sluggish. She squints so much you can't even see her eyes properly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Did you read the script already? What did you like about it? What about OwO attracted you? Do you know what the lion's head is for?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where's your resume? What works have you produced?

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Ahhh... so many questions. Is this an interview?

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Sorry, I forgot the first few questions already. Can I just answer the last one? About my works...
She avoids your questions, but then responds again after a while.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: To tell the truth, I've been in Dillywood for many years, but I haven't produced anything worth showing... Hehe...
...Okay, at least she's honest. It's true that while Dillywood has many glamorous celebrities, there are also a lot of small potatoes who struggle to realize their dreams.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: But it's fine. There's a saying: Don't dwell on past glory... The true masterpiece is always the next one...

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: That'd be the new movie I'm making with OwO, right? From the moment we met, there was dazzling fantasy all over.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: That's right! It's because you're a great director!
The two of them tilt their heads and giggle, casting you aside. They've used shameless nonsense to avoid all the serious questions.
This is clearly a scam. This woman obviously belongs to another major demographic of Dillywood—con-artists who lie through their teeth every day.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Why are you trying to get close to OwO?

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: You still have questions? Can you ask me tomorrow? OwO said the little clapper would bring us some food... If you can do that, I'd be very thankful.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Umm... I'm really hungry and sleepy. I haven't slept indoors for several days... Can you please help me out?
...Could the reason why she wants to join the crew be...

steps.speaker: Option
options: OwO! Did you tell her that room and board will be provided for?!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmm? Yeah! When you got me into My Best Cool Car, didn't you say that I'd get room and board, too? Of course we should treat all crew members equally!
How can that be the same?!

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Haha... Better get some rest before work starts... Haha... Yawn...
She waves her hand, and lies down with a thud.
